desc: This bronze statuette is of a griffon rampant. It can become a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.actors24.Actor.mmGriffon0000000]{Griffon} for up to 6 hours. Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 5 days have passed.
This item's limited uses represent the 5 days required before the figurine can be used again.
name: bronze griffon
